methodology.observation_window_basis: The historical run followed the August 27 report and covered developments through its August 28 observation time.
methodology.ranking_basis: Signal strength rather than popularity, emphasizing deployment, operating history, approved therapies, hardware development, and production scaling.
methodology.source_policy: Prefer primary company, government, regulatory, and research-institution announcements.
methodology.repeat_policy: The August 26 and August 27 subjects were screened out; the RoboSense item excluded shipment facts previously disclosed in July and used only new commercialization milestones.

provenance.notes: Findings, source links, reported category directions, and the original observation timestamp were preserved. Exact unavailable fallback-JSON-only metadata was not inferred.

findings.headline: Anthropic opens a standard for AI agents to control laboratory and manufacturing hardware
findings.summary: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard, a model- and device-agnostic specification for AI agents to discover and operate programmable physical equipment across laboratories and factories.
findings.why_it_matters: A common abstraction layer could reduce weeks of bespoke hardware integration to hours or minutes and let agents operate heterogeneous equipment.
findings.trend_statement: The AI-agent stack is extending from software tools into standardized physical-world interfaces.

source_links.title: Anthropic — Model Hardware Standard research preview

findings.headline: Autonomous airport cleaning passes 200 robots and 100,000 operating hours
findings.summary: SoftBank Robotics America and Flagship Aviation Services reported more than 200 autonomous cleaning robots across 25 locations, exceeding 100,000 operating hours and approaching 500 million square feet cleaned.
findings.why_it_matters: Operating hours and fleet expansion in continuously operating public environments are stronger diffusion evidence than demonstrations.
findings.trend_statement: Commercial robotics is moving from pilots toward repeatable fleet deployments.

source_links.title: SoftBank Robotics — Airport automation fleet milestone

findings.headline: FDA approves the first oral treatment specifically indicated for adult dermatomyositis
findings.summary: The FDA approved Lisraya (brepocitinib) for adults with dermatomyositis, the first FDA-approved oral therapy specifically indicated for the rare autoimmune disease.
findings.why_it_matters: A targeted immune-pathway drug moved into an approved commercial treatment for a high-unmet-need indication previously served largely by therapies developed for other diseases.
findings.trend_statement: Precision immunology is expanding into smaller and historically underserved autoimmune indications.

source_links.title: FDA — First oral drug for adult dermatomyositis

findings.headline: NASA-backed quantum gravity sensor advances into hardware development
findings.summary: Infleqtion announced a $20 million NASA follow-on award for the JPL-led Quantum Gravity Gradiometer Pathfinder, moving the effort into sensor-head, electronics, and microgravity testing.
findings.why_it_matters: The program advanced quantum sensing from physics demonstrations toward flight-qualified instrumentation.
findings.trend_statement: Quantum technology is beginning to diffuse through specialized sensing, timing, and navigation applications.

source_links.title: Infleqtion — NASA quantum gravity mission award

findings.headline: RoboSense scales the component layer beneath physical AI
findings.summary: RoboSense reported rapid robotics LiDAR growth, full-scale volume production and delivery of its E2 LiDAR, and upcoming commercial deliveries across camera, tactile-sensor, and robotic-joint products.
findings.why_it_matters: Robot intelligence cannot diffuse without inexpensive, mass-produced sensing and actuation hardware, making component commercialization a useful measure of real activity.
findings.trend_statement: Physical AI is developing a dedicated industrial supply chain for perception, touch, and actuation.

source_links.title: RoboSense — 2026 interim results and commercialization milestones
